The Happy Camper

The first of our custom adventure builds, Mammoth is designed with all essentials for short-term travel. It features added cabinet storage, an electric water heater, built-in water purification, and an evaporative cooler for comfort on warmer days.

BUILD
FEATURES

Kitchen Electricity Plumbing Heating/Cooling Aesthetic Storage Misc

Kitchen

  • Acacia butcher block counter with custom stain option
  • Single portable induction burner for flexible meal prep
  • Top-mount stainless steel sink paired with sleek faucet  
  • 3 cubic foot fridge-freezer combo for efficient food storage

Electricity

  • 400W rooftop solar array with efficient PWM charging system
  • Dual 200Ah AGM batteries for steady, off-grid power support
  • 2500W pure sine inverter for safe AC device usage
  • Two 110V outlets with built-in USB-A and USB-C ports
  • Battery isolator to recharge system while engine runs
  • Shore hookup option for charging at powered campsites  

Plumbing

  • 5-gallon cassette toilet for easy waste removal and mobility
  • Rear-access outdoor shower for quick rinse and cleaning 
  • 23-gallon fresh water tank sized for short trips
  • 7-gallon greywater bin mounted beneath sink
  • Bosch water heater delivering reliable hot water flow

Heating/cooling

  • Fresair evaporative cooler for low-power climate control
  • Maxxair roof fan for steady airflow and ventilation
  • Standard insulation kit to manage interior temperature

Aesthetic

  • Smooth shiplap wall panels painted for a clean finish
  • Stained natural wood ceiling with customizable tone
  • Wood-look vinyl flooring with color options available

Storage

  • Dual overhead storage compartments for upper-level gear
  • Two-door cabinet mounted beneath the kitchen countertop
  • Rear garage area below bed for large item storage
  • Smooth-glide drawer setup under the counter (layout dependent)
  • Extra cabinet beneath counter, added if space allows
  • Base insulation throughout to protect stored items from heat

misc

  • Full-size memory foam mattress for added sleeping comfort
  • Driver and passenger seats with full swivel rotation
  • Dual gas and carbon monoxide detection system installed
  • Fire extinguisher mounted for emergency preparedness
  • Adjustable Lagun table for meals or remote work
  • Dimmable LED lighting recessed into ceiling panels

interior HIGHLIGHTS

EXTERIOR UPGRADES

PACKAGE UPGRADES

Four Peaks Package

Designed for small families or travel partners, this layout includes foldable jump seats and an additional bed perfect for adventures with more people.

Premium Insulation Package

Get superior warmth and natural moisture control with Havelock wool insulation a sustainable solution for year-round vanlife comfort.

Necessities Off Road Package

Essential upgrades like side steps, perimeter lighting, and a front-mounted light bar make off-road navigation safer and more accessible.

Advanced Off Road Package

Take your build to the next level with a lift kit, rock sliders, bumper, spare tire carrier, and full lighting built for extreme trails and backcountry exploration.

Advanced Interior Light Package

The advanced interior lighting package with a light bar and perimeter lighting enhances visibility, ambiance, and functionality for an immersive driving experience.

Advanced Exterior Light Package

Light bar and perimeter lighting

Wheels and Tires Package

Choose from all-terrain tires, custom rims, and durable wheels to improve your grip, stance, and style across rugged routes.

Window Cover Package

Van Essentials covers offer full privacy, sun protection, and thermal regulation a stealth camping must-have for comfort and security.
